decisions.reason: As a newly launched 2024 product that fits the firm's machinery-oriented water-control business, management is likely to continue backing it because recent investment can still be justified and weak early uptake can be seen as temporary.

Although an energy management system is somewhat less central than the firm's physical equipment and is only generally mentioned on the website, its recent launch and the firm's commitment to the offering make management more likely to persist than to withdraw quickly.

Because this 2024 product has its own webpage and is closely aligned with the firm's core water-level regulation equipment, the firm has made a visible commitment and is therefore especially likely to keep it on the market.
